t.zh: 到这里，每个新值都只看原图的一个位置。可模糊、找边这样的处理，要看一个像素周围的一片：<wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>。最常用的一种，是把邻域里的像素各乘一个权重再相加，这组权重叫<wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>的卷积核。
t.en: So far each new value looks at one position of the original. Blurring or finding edges needs the patch around a pixel: <wiki-ref to="pixel-vs-local-operator"></wiki-ref>. The commonest kind multiplies each pixel of the neighbourhood by a weight and adds them up; the weights are the kernel of a <wiki-ref to="linear-filter"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：让一组权重沿着一行滑过去，每个位置算一次加权和，结果是什么样？先手算一行，再接成电路：输入一张图和左、中、右三个权重。
t.en: This level asks: sliding three weights along a row and taking the weighted sum at each position, what comes out? First work out a row by hand, then wire it: an image and the left, centre and right weights.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>：一组权重滑过整张图，每个位置算一次加权和。只算三格都在图里的位置，输出比原图窄 2。
after.en: This is the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>: a set of weights slides over the image, one weighted sum per position. Taking only positions with all three cells inside, the output is 2 narrower.

brief.zh: 权重左 1、中 0、右 −1 滑过这一行：写出三格都在图里的每个位置的加权和。
brief.en: Slide the weights left 1, centre 0, right −1 along this row: write the weighted sum at each position whose three cells are all inside.

hint.zh: 第一个位置以 x = 1 为中心：1 × 左邻 + 0 × 自己 + (−1) × 右邻。
hint.en: The first position is centred on x = 1: 1 × left + 0 × here + (−1) × right.

why.zh: 这是右邻减左邻：权重左 1、右 −1，是左邻减右邻。权重跟着位置走，不要颠倒。
why.en: That is right less left: with the left weight 1 and the right −1 it is left less right. The weights go with their positions.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref>读出图的宽 w 和高 h。只算三格都在图里的位置：输出宽 w − 2，第 x 格以原图的 x + 1 为中心。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:size"></part-ref> gives an image's width w and height h. Take only positions with all three cells inside: the output is w − 2 wide, its cell x centred on the original x + 1.

brief.zh: 输入一张图和权重 a、b、c：交出每个位置 a × 左邻 + b × 自己 + c × 右邻。
brief.en: Given an image and the weights a, b, c, give a × left + b × here + c × right at each position.

hint.zh: 输出的每格要取原图的三个像素：它们的 x 各是多少？
hint.en: Each output cell reads three pixels of the original: what is each one's x?
